headline: Tuesday at the Lake: Heat Builds, Farmhouse Spotlight, Landing Market Day
lede: Tomorrow brings classic mid-90s Branson heat with mostly sunny skies and a light chance of an afternoon pop-up. Perfect weather to start early, stay hydrated, and enjoy shaded or indoor options in the afternoon.

featured.title: Landing Farmers Market
featured.where: South lot by Bass Pro Shop
featured.why: Fresh local produce, handmade crafts, and live music — the weekly Tuesday highlight for first-timers

plan: Dawn — Head out early for Table Rock fishing or a shaded hike before the heat builds (carry-forward tactics apply)
Afternoon — Indoor air-conditioned options: shows, Silver Dollar City, or the Aquarium at the Landing
Dusk — Cool off with a late dinner at the rotating spotlight restaurant and stroll the Branson Landing fountains
indoor: Silver Dollar City (early entry recommended on hot days)
The Aquarium at the Landing or Titanic Museum
Evening shows — most theaters are climate-controlled
honesty: No fresh scouts available for 2026-08-29. All content carried forward from most recent verified reports with honest "verify locally" notes where sources were not re-checked today. Restaurant spotlight rotates to Farmhouse Restaurant (Tuesday). Weather from Open-Meteo.
